name.text: Permutations II 4 - Count the repeats (select missing words)

questiontext.text:
Choose the correct value from each menu. Remember: when some items are identical, divide the total arrangements by the factorial of each repeated group.

Part A: Arrange all the letters of the word BANANA.

  1. The total number of letters is [[1]]
  2. The letter A appears [[2]] times and the letter N appears [[3]] times. B appears once.
  3. Number of arrangements = 6! ÷ ([[2]]! × [[3]]!)
  4. Number of arrangements = 720 ÷ 12 = [[5]]

Part B: Arrange all the letters of the word STATISTICS.

  1. The total number of letters is [[4]]
  2. The letter S appears [[2]] times, the letter T appears [[2]] times and the letter I appears [[3]] times. The letters A and C appear once each.
  3. Number of arrangements = 10! ÷ ([[2]]! × [[2]]! × [[3]]!)
  4. Number of arrangements = 3 628 800 ÷ 72 = [[6]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Count the letters, then find any letter that repeats. Swapping identical letters does not make a new arrangement, so divide by the factorial of each repeated group.

\(\text{BANANA: } \dfrac{6!}{3!\,2!} = \dfrac{720}{12} = 60\)

\(\text{STATISTICS: } \dfrac{10!}{3!\,3!\,2!} = \dfrac{3\,628\,800}{72} = 50\,400\)
